youtubeScript.title: How AI Agents Will Change the Open Web (For Beginners)
youtubeScript.hook: The open web as you know it is about to change forever—and AI agents are leading the way. Instead of clicking around endless web pages, soon you might just ask an AI to do it all for you. Let's break down how this works in plain English!

sections.heading: How AI Agents Fetch Information
sections.narration: Think about how you usually find things online today. You open a search engine, type a question, scan a dozen links, and click around to find what you need. But AI agents do something completely different. They read the web for you in seconds, extracting exact answers without making you click through banners, pop-ups, and menus. It's like having a super-fast research assistant who never gets tired.
sections.bRoll: Animation of a person typing a query into a friendly AI assistant interface.

sections.heading: The Shift to Machine-Readable Pages
sections.narration: Because AI agents care about facts and data rather than flashy animations and pretty designs, websites are starting to evolve. In the future, creators and businesses might design pages specifically so machines can read them easily. Your favorite sites aren't going away, but their behind-the-scenes structure is getting a major upgrade to speak fluent AI.
sections.bRoll: Side-by-side comparison of a busy human website vs a clean, structured data feed.

sections.heading: What This Means for You
sections.narration: So, what does this mean for everyday web users and creators? For you, it means faster answers and less digital clutter. For creators, it's an exciting opportunity to share information in ways that AI can easily understand and share with the world. The open web is becoming smarter, simpler, and much more helpful.
sections.bRoll: Friendly creator talking to the camera with clean graphics showing future web icons.

youtubeScript.outro: If you found this helpful, hit that subscribe button! And drop a comment below with your favorite website—let's discuss how it might look when only AI agents visit it!
